blocks.text: TUCSON, Arizona— Bryce James followed his man along the baseline and turned just in time to see a Northern Arizona player charging down the lane with the ball. James wheeled around to meet the ballhandler in the paint, soaring up to swat away a two-handed dunk attempt, head just below the rim. The highlight-reel block triggered a roar from the McKale Center crowd and an Arizona fast break that led to a timeout.
